mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot WHERE p_num = #{pNum} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.* FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT p_num, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot GROUP BY p_num ) latest ON s.p_num = latest.p_num AND s.create_time = latest.max_time WHERE s.risk_level = #{riskLevel} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT s.* FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT p_num, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot GROUP BY p_num ) latest ON s.p_num = latest.p_num AND s.create_time = latest.max_time ORDER BY s.risk_level DESC, s.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.p_num) FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT p_num, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM biz_stock_risk_snapshot GROUP BY p_num ) latest ON s.p_num = latest.p_num AND s.create_time = latest.max_time WHERE s.risk_level = #{riskLevel}
